outline.title: 宝葫芦里的反向山谷 / The Reverse Valley in the Magic Gourd
outline.summary: 夏天和林老师在老爷爷的小院里遇到宝葫芦失控，七兄弟和老爷爷一起被吸进反向山谷，出口还被蛇精封住。山谷有一条特殊规则：每个本领都必须先帮助同伴，才会变成能点亮出口的七色印记。队伍在夏天的提醒和林老师的安排下，改掉各自硬闯的习惯，把本领变成互相配合的步骤，一枚一枚集齐印记。最后，七色印记按正确顺序放回宝葫芦口，大家带着老爷爷回到小院，蛇精的咒语也失效了。

chapters.title: 掉进反向山谷 / Falling into the Reverse Valley
chapters.summary: 宝葫芦把大家吸进反向山谷后，出口立刻缩紧，蛇精的咒语让每一次硬闯都更危险。林老师让夏天先别催着兄弟们冲，夏天带着大娃去扶起断裂的石桥，三娃在旁边挡住滚石。石桥被扶稳后，第一枚七色印记亮了起来，大家也第一次看懂了山谷的规则。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: 适合用过去式描述被吸进山谷、第一次找到规则和印记亮起的经过。

chapters.title: 学会先帮人 / Learning to Help First
chapters.summary: 前方的路变成又窄又热的石缝，谁先冲都会被风吹散。二娃先找出风口和安全路，五娃再把热石上的火苗压下去，林老师让夏天把队伍分成两组跟进。大家穿过石缝时，第二和第三枚印记一起出现，通往山谷中心的路被打开了。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: 可以自然练习正在发生的动作和随后发生的结果，描述找路、灭火和前进。

chapters.title: 荆棘石台 / The Thorny Stone Platform
chapters.summary: 山谷中心外围着荆棘网，老爷爷被困在高台上，直接冲进去只会把网越收越紧。六娃先隐身进去把绳子递给老爷爷，四娃再按他的指点烧开一条安全口子。老爷爷回到队伍身边，还认出石台上的刻纹，提醒大家出口需要按七枚印记的顺序排放。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: 适合用过去式和进行时描述潜入、救援和正在变化的荆棘状态。

chapters.title: 宝葫芦换了用法 / A New Way to Use the Gourd
chapters.summary: 蛇精开始反向念咒，最后两枚印记被拉到葫芦边上，谁只想硬收都会被弹回来。七娃不再把宝葫芦当成抓人的工具，而是让三娃顶住反弹、大娃稳住葫芦口，自己把葫芦口对准空出的岩缝。宝葫芦没有吞掉队伍，反而把第六和第七枚印记送回大家手里，七枚印记终于集齐。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: 可以自然练习正在进行的反咒、配合动作和结果变化，突出七娃改变用法。

chapters.title: 七色印记开门 / The Seven Marks Open the Door
chapters.summary: 七枚印记都到齐了，可出口还会根据“先帮谁、后用谁”的顺序重新排列，顺序错了就会再缩回去。夏天举着印记提醒顺序，林老师让七兄弟依次把自己最先帮助同伴的那一步放进出口图案里。七色光门打开后，大家带着老爷爷回到小院，蛇精的咒语也跟着散开了。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: 适合用一般现在时说明出口规则，也可以用将来时表达大家接下来要回到小院。

args.title: 掉进反向山谷 / Falling into the Reverse Valley
args.cleanText: The magic gourd suddenly pulled everyone into the Reverse Valley. Behind them, the narrow exit became smaller as the Snake Spirit chanted outside. Big Brother rushed toward it, but a violent force threw him back. Grandpa warned the brothers to slow down, while Ms. Lin asked Summer to watch the valley before anyone tried again. Summer noticed a broken stone bridge blocking the path and led Big Brother there. He lifted the heavy stones while Third Brother blocked falling rocks with his strong body. Together, they restored the crossing for their companions. A bright red mark appeared above the safe path, and everyone finally understood the valley's strange rule: a power worked only after it helped someone else.

args.title: 学会先帮人 / Learning to Help First
args.cleanText: Beyond the bridge, the path narrowed into a hot stone passage between dark rocks. Fierce wind pushed at anyone who moved ahead alone. Second Brother studied the walls and called, “The wind is blowing through three holes, and I am finding a safe route along the left side.” He then marked the calmer path with small stones for everyone. Flames still danced across the hot ground. Fifth Brother said, “I am pouring water over the fire, and the rocks are becoming cooler now.” Ms. Lin asked Summer to divide the team into two groups. Summer guided the brothers forward after Second Brother, and Fifth Brother extinguished every flame. When all companions crossed the narrow gap, two shining marks appeared and opened the road to the valley's center.

args.title: 荆棘石台 / The Thorny Stone Platform
args.cleanText: At the valley's center, a tightening thorn net surrounded a high stone platform where Grandpa waited. Sixth Brother turned invisible and slipped inside instead of attacking the thorns. He reached Grandpa and passed him a rope. Grandpa whispered, “The thorn net is growing tighter whenever someone pushes it, so follow the open spaces beside my platform.” Sixth Brother held the rope while Grandpa climbed down. From inside, he called, “The thorns are moving away from the right edge now.” Fourth Brother checked everyone's position, then burned a safe opening through that edge. The team rescued Grandpa from the platform and gathered around him. He recognized carved lines on the stone and explained that the exit required all seven marks in the correct order.

args.title: 宝葫芦换了用法 / A New Way to Use the Gourd
args.cleanText: The Snake Spirit began chanting backward outside the valley, and the last two marks flew toward the magic gourd. Each brother who tried to grab them fell backward. Seventh Brother watched the gourd and said, “The spell is pulling the marks toward its mouth, but I am planning a different use for it. We must guide them instead of swallowing them.” Third Brother stood in front of the team and resisted the returning force. Big Brother held the gourd's opening steady while Seventh Brother aimed it at an empty crack. “The marks are passing through the gourd now,” he called. He sent them safely into his companions' hands instead of trapping anyone. The sixth and seventh marks shone together, and the team finally completed the seven-color set.

args.title: 七色印记开门 / The Seven Marks Open the Door
args.cleanText: Although all seven marks were ready, the exit kept changing their places. Grandpa pointed to the carved pattern, and Summer raised the marks where everyone could see them. Ms. Lin told the brothers to remember whom each power had helped first. Summer said, “The door follows our helpful steps, and a wrong order closes it again. Follow the story we made together.” Summer said, “We place our marks into the glowing pattern in that order.” She checked every color while Ms. Lin kept the team calm. Seventh Brother said, “The last mark belongs here. When it fits into place, the light will carry us home, and we will lead Grandpa.” A rainbow gateway opened, and everyone returned safely to the courtyard as the Snake Spirit's spell faded away.
